claim: AAAI-26 uses a two-phase review process where Phase 1 (2 human reviews + 1 non-decisional AI-generated review) can reject a paper outright, and authors only get a rebuttal opportunity for papers that survive to Phase 2.
stance_target: under-scoped submissions risk being screened out before any chance to argue their case
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track submission process
quoted_support: Phase 1: Two reviews supplemented by one AI-generated, non-decisional review. Phase 2: Additional reviews for papers not rejected in Phase 1. Author response after Phase 2, only for papers not rejected in Phase 1.

claim: AAAI-26 requires supplementary material and code to be submitted only 3 days after the full-paper deadline, signaling that code/artifact submission at review time is standard practice.
stance_target: code submission at review time is an established norm, not an optional add-on
quoted_support: August 4, 2025 Supplementary material and code due by 11:59 PM UTC-12

claim: AAAI-26 main-track papers are limited to 7 pages of technical content plus unlimited reference pages, under double-blind review.
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Main Technical Track submission format
quoted_support: Submissions may consist of up to 7 pages of technical content plus additional pages solely for reference
